CITY CLERK REPORT - NOTICE NO. N2M23-43

The City Clerk hereby reports that she duly gave notice of the Special Meeting of the City
Council being held this morning pursuant to the order of the Mayor and in accordance with
Section 54956 of the Government Code of the State of California.

1.  CITY COUNCIL STRATEGIC PLANNING SESSION – F2M23-35, R2M23-21

  The City Council, City Manager, Department Heads and Facilitator William Kelly,
  President/CEO of Kelly Associates Management Group, held a strategic planning
  session on March 30, 2023 to update the City’s Strategic Plan adopted in 2021. The new
  Draft Strategic Plan contains six Goals, defined as follows: Goal 1: Enhance Public
  Safety; Goal 2: Improve Infrastructure and Mobility; Goal 3: Create a Strong Financial
  Base and Strong Economic Base (Economic Development); Goal 4: Enhance

  2
4-17-23
   Transparency and Open Governance; Goal 5: Promote Sustainability; and, Goal 6:
  Improve Housing Opportunities, and an Implementation Plan to provide details and
  metrics to monitor the plan. The City Council will review and discuss the Draft Strategic
  Plan. The City Council will also consider adoption of a resolution approving and
  establishing a Citywide Governance Policy for elected officials.

  Recommended Action:  City Council consider adoption of Resolution No. R2M23-
  21 entitled: A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Alhambra, California,
  approving and establishing a Citywide Governance Policy for elected officials; and,
  review the 2023 City of Alhambra Draft Strategic Plan and direct staff as deemed
  appropriate.

ADJOURNMENT: The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Alhambra City Council will be
held on Monday, April 24, 2023, in the Alhambra City Hall Council Chambers, 111 South First
Street, Alhambra, California, commencing at 6:00 p.m.

  NOTICE
Agenda Items: Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to the items listed
on this agenda are on file with the City Clerk in Alhambra City Hall, located at 111 South First Street,
Alhambra, California, and are available for inspection during regular office hours, Monday through
Thursday from 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. If you would like to sign-up to receive the City Council meeting
agenda and staff reports packet, please visit the City’s website at www.cityofalhambra.org and you
will be able to submit your email address on the homepage to the subscription service. Pursuant to
Government Code Section 54957.5(b), materials related to agenda items for regular meetings of the
Alhambra City Council that are distributed less than 72 hours prior to that meeting, will be made
available for public inspection at the Alhambra City Clerk’s Office.

Americans with Disabilities Act: If you require special assistance to participate in any City
meeting (including assisted listening devices), please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 570-
5090. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable
arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

Translation Services Requests: If you require translation services in order to participate in a
meeting please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (626) 570-5090. All requests for translation services
shall be made by 4 p.m. the Thursday prior to the City Council meeting. If translation is not
requested by 4 p.m. the Thursday prior to the City Council meeting, staff will try to accommodate the
request if possible.

   RESOLUTION R2M23-21

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ALHAMBRA,
  CALIFORNIA, APPROVING AND ESTABLISHING A CITYWIDE
  GOVERNANCE POLICY FOR ELECTED OFFICIALS

WHEREAS, at the November 3, 2020 General Municipal Election, Alhambra voters approved
Measure V, a Charter amendment to establish campaign finance rules for local elections and to
establish by-district City Council elections and Measure V was codified into the Alhambra City
Charter under Sections 101(A) through 101(L); and,

WHEREAS, prior to the adoption of Measure V, each member of the Council was elected in at-
large elections by the registered voters of the entire City; and,

WHEREAS, the City conducted its first district-based elections for Districts 1, 2 and 5 at the
November 2022 General Municipal Election and the City will conduct district-based elections for
Districts 3 and 4 at the November 2024 General Municipal Election; thus, following the November
2024 election, all five Councilmembers will have been elected by voters of the district in which
they reside; and,

WHEREAS, the City Council understands the value of citywide governance regardless of the
method from which City Council members are elected; and,

WHEREAS, governing citywide allows for the continuation of inclusive and accessible customer
service, the most effective use of taxpayer resources, and consistency in City services; and,

WHEREAS, each member of the City Council will continue to serve all of the people of Alhambra.

  NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, by the City Council of the City of Alhambra, as
follows:

Section 1.  The City Council will govern on a citywide basis, considering the needs and
  interests of the entire community.

Section 2.  It is the goal of the City Council to provide leadership to City staff, officials, and
  representatives so that the City will continue to provide inclusive and accessible
  customer service to the entire community and facilitate an excellent quality of life
  for all.

Section 3.  Each member of the City Council will help all members of the community
  regardless of the district in which a resident resides or a proposed project is
  located, or from which a Councilmember is elected.

Section 4.  Professional management by the City Manager utilizing best management
  practices, with policy leadership and direction from the City Council, consistent
  with the Alhambra Charter and Municipal Code will continue.

Section 5.  Resources will continue to be allocated based on long-term strategic planning
  efforts, with citywide considerations of equitable service levels and financial
  capacity.
 Section 6.  City Council fiscal management, best practices, and City systems will continue to
  reflect services provided to all residents citywide.

Section 7.  The City Council directs the City Clerk to include this resolution in materials
  prepared for new City Council Candidates and as a part of City Councilmember
  on-boarding materials.

  PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED, at a meeting of the City Council of the City of
Alhambra, California, on this 17th day of April 2023.

  ___________________________________
  ADELE ANDRADE-STADLER, MAYOR
